title: Bing Ads report streaming: generator lifetime, BOM and laziness pitfalls
answers: Why is the Bing Ads reporting manager not created when get_performance_report is called?
BOM appears in first column name of Bing Ads report
Testing generator-based Bing Ads report functions
body:
`iter_report_row_pages` (bing_ads/utils.py) and `BingAdsClient.get_performance_report` (bing_ads/client.py) are generators now.
- Nothing runs (manager creation, SDK working dir, download) until the generator is drained; tests must wrap calls in `list(...)` (see tests/test_bing_ads_client.py).
- The `yield from` sits inside the SDK working directory and inside the try, so the SDK dir lives for the whole read and mid-download faults still go through `_wrap_with_fault_detail`.
- The temp dir lives as long as iteration; an abandoned iterator must be closed.
- The BOM is stripped by decoding with `utf-8-sig` in `io.TextIOWrapper(..., newline="")` over `zip_file.open`. There is no manual prefix strip, so do not decode with plain utf-8 or the first column becomes `﻿TimePeriod`.
- `iter_csv_row_pages` must not drain its source before yielding; `test_iter_csv_row_pages_reads_lazily` guards this.
- `download_file` returning None still means empty report (yield nothing).
applies: Editing or testing bing_ads/utils.py and client.py report download/parse path.

search: Bing Ads report streaming functions are generators where nothing executes until the generator is fully drained; tests must wrap calls in list() to trigger execution. The yield from sits inside the SDK working directory context manager and try block, so the temporary directory persists throughout iteration and download faults still receive fault wrapping. Abandoned iterators must be manually closed. The BOM is stripped via utf-8-sig decoding in io.TextIOWrapper with newline="" over zip_file.open—do not use plain utf-8 or the first column becomes corrupted with the BOM character. iter_csv_row_pages must not drain its source generator before yielding; test_iter_csv_row_pages_reads_lazily guards this lazy behavior. download_file returning None still signals an empty report (yields nothing, no exception). Applies to edits in bing_ads/utils.py:iter_report_row_pages, bing_ads/client.py:get_performance_report and BingAdsClient.get_performance_report, and their tests.
